title: Java NPE with a real cause chain
description: A Spring service throws a NullPointerException and the real reason is one Caused by level down: the customer has no active contract.
demonstrates: The control case. Rich log context, correlation id, application frames and a cause chain - the tool should localise the fault at ContractRepository and rank the missing-contract hypothesis first.

title: Java generic RuntimeException with no context
description: The importer logs 'import failed' and rethrows a bare RuntimeException, so the message says nothing and there is no request id.
demonstrates: Why a vague message and a generic type destroy fix confidence even though the frames are perfectly good.

title: Node TypeError with a live API key in the log
description: A webhook handler dereferences undefined, and the log line above it contains a live secret key.
demonstrates: The critical red flag: good frames and a precise message, but a credential is exposed in the pasted output.

title: Go panic with a repeating frame
description: A goroutine panics with an index out of range and the same frame repeats nine times.
demonstrates: How a repeating frame turns the search for the deepest frame into a search for the loop that never terminates.

title: Log-only paste with no trace and PII
description: Four error lines with no timestamps, no stack trace and a customer email address repeated.
demonstrates: The floor case. Nothing to localise, nothing to reproduce, and personal data in the output.

title: Five occurrences of the same night
description: Three identical NPEs, one index error and one connection refusal, separated by lines of three dashes.
demonstrates: The clustering view: one dominant signature, a long tail, and the point where a paste stops being one bug and becomes a pattern.
